## Annotation

VCH describes CSIL as an individualized-funding alternative for clients who can direct their care: the employer receives money from VCH to hire, manage, and pay home-support staff. The page does not give a founding year.

The handbook/guidebook file linked from the page was not opened in this pass (the landing page lists it; the PDF itself is a follow-up item).
